title: Adenosine A2A receptor signaling in the choroid plexus and its role in CSF secretion and ventriculomegaly in hydrocephalus
core_idea: Investigate whether aberrant adenosine A2A receptor (A2AR) signaling in the choroid plexus links brain insults to increased CSF production and ventricular enlargement, and whether this occurs via parallel PI3K/AKT-dependent SPAK phosphorylation and NF-κB-dependent transcriptional regulation of ATP1A2, with assessment of A2AR antagonism as a therapeutic strategy.
tldr: This work examines the hypothesis that choroid plexus A2A receptor signaling mediates CSF hypersecretion and ventriculomegaly through PI3K/AKT–SPAK and NF-κB–ATP1A2 pathways and explores repurposing the FDA-approved A2AR antagonist istradefylline as a potential treatment approach.
